_comment: The build policy every recipe image is built under, owned by this repository (D3). build_options and build_security are build-key inputs (src/recipe_tooling/build_plan.py); build_resources.processes sets the build's nproc ulimit and is not a key input. Values copied from Vonk Forge's build_policy_projection at 25c4dde1. A change here changes every key: the next run rebuilds every image, and each recipe re-checks on hardware.
